tor_control_socket.description: Path to the Unix domain socket of the local Tor control interface (e.g., /run/tor/control.socket). Requires Tor to be configured with ControlSocket enabled.

state_directory.description: Persistent state directory where OnionBalance saves service descriptors, session keys, and internal metadata.

descriptor_directory.description: Directory for storing plaintext descriptor files (if not using state_directory only). Optional but recommended for diagnostics.

debug.description: Enable verbose logging for debugging. Set to true during setup or troubleshooting; false for production.

services.description: List of hidden services to load-balance. Each service must have a .onion hostname and at least one backend.

hostname.description: The base32-encoded .onion hostname (e.g., exampleonionxyz.onion). Must match the public key of the service.

version.description: Hidden service protocol version (2 or 3). Must match the backend's service version.

private_key.description: Ed25519 private key (in base64 or PEM format) for the hidden service. Required for v3 services if not pre-installed in Tor.

v3_public_key.description: Ed25519 public key (base64 or hex) for the hidden service. Required for v3 services unless private_key is provided.

authorized_clients.description: Optional list of clients allowed to submit descriptor updates (for multi-admin setups).

client_key.description: Ed25519 private key of the client (used to sign descriptor uploads).

v3_auth_key.description: Optional Ed25519 public key (base64) of the client for authentication (if using v3 auth keys).

backends.description: List of backend hidden services (or real servers behind v2-only proxies) to route traffic to.

address.description: Onion address of the backend (e.g., backend1xyz.onion). Must be a valid .onion v2 or v3 address.

weight.description: Relative traffic weight for this backend (e.g., 2 means it receives ~2× traffic of a backend with weight 1).

max_upload_threads.description: Maximum number of parallel descriptor upload jobs to Tor. Increase if upload latency is high.

upload_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) per descriptor upload attempt. Increase on slow or unreliable Tor control connections.

heartbeat_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between descriptor updates and backend health checks.

num_descriptors.description: Number of descriptors OnionBalance should keep per service (for redundancy and Tor’s descriptor rotation logic).
